title: Removes deprecated tax information fields from the `Customer` object
summary: Deprecates tax information for Customers. To learn more, see the migration guide.

migrationNotes.text: This change simplifies the Customer object and associated methods by removing the deprecated tax_info and tax_info_verification fields in favor of the tax_ids field. This consolidation and removal of deprecated fields lets you work with a more streamlined and up-to-date Customer object, aligning with Stripe’s latest tax handling capabilities.
